question: The marked price of a shirt is Rs. 2,000. It is sold at a discount of 15%. The shopkeeper has allowed a further discount of 5% due to off season . Find the selling price of the shirt.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**15%= 3/20

5% = 1/20

⇒ 400 unit = 2000

⇒ 1 unit = 5

⇒ 323 unit = 5 × 323 = 1615 

**Selling price of the shirt = Rs. 1615**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__** Given :

Marked Price of shirt = Rs 2000

First discount = 15% 

Second discount = 5%

**Formula Used :**

Selling Price = Marked Price × (100 - Discount%)/100

**Calculation :**

Selling price

⇒ 2000 × ((100-15)/(100))((100-5)/(100))

⇒ 2000 × 85/100 × 95/100

⇒ 1615 Rs.

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 1615.**
